Kai (Product): Quick sync: customer wants private pilot w/ 99.95% SLA and p95 <200ms for short prompts. They also want BYOK KMS and 30d audit retention. Need quick cross-team blockers + ETAs.

Rajat (Eng-runtime): Latency ok with dedicated pool + prewarm and model pin. Rough: 10 working days for prewarm + canary hooks. Need perf harness.

Maya (Infra): Can reserve instances if we prioritize. VPC peering and NIC tuning will take ~5 working days. HSM network rules add extra.

Luis (Security): BYOK reduces scope. I'll prepare BYOK checklist + run a 1hr risk review. Full HSM will be longer (2+ sprints).

Priya (Customer Success): Customer needs demo in ~8 weeks and daily latency reports during pilot. They can accept BYOK for pilot.

SRE-bot: Reminder: create SLIs and runbook, include auto-fallback to hosted model on breach.

Kai (Product): Proposed owners: Rajat (runtime), Maya (infra), Luis (security), Priya (cust comms). Action items: I'll create epic and flag pilot-priority today. Sync tomorrow 11am PT.
